meta.regenerateCommand: cd packages/core && pnpm build && (cd scripts/interop/bc-helper && ./fetch-bcprov.sh && javac -cp bcprov-jdk18on-1.86.jar BCHelper.java) && pnpm exec tsx scripts/interop/generate-bc-vectors.mts
meta.note: Cross-implementation interop vector: this SDK vs. BouncyCastle (Java), a second independent codebase alongside CIRCL (Go) — see circl-*.json in this directory. Not an ACVP vector — see src/nist-vectors.test.ts and docs/compliance/ for those. Uses the non-deprecated org.bouncycastle.crypto.{signers,kems}/params API (FIPS 203/204 final names), not the older org.bouncycastle.pqc.crypto.{mlkem,mldsa} classes of the same name (deprecated in favor of these) and never the legacy round-3 "Dilithium"/"Kyber" classes, which are a different algorithm. The cross-check that matters (does BC accept/produce byte-compatible material) was performed once, here, at generation time; CI re-checks only this SDK's own behaviour against the committed bytes (a regression guard), since Java/BC never runs in CI.
